en: In a vacuum, gravity accelerates a heavy bowling ball and a light feather at the exact same rate.
Static friction keeps a heavy wooden box stationary on a ramp by opposing the applied pushing force.
An inclined plane reduces the effort force needed to lift a box by increasing the distance you push it.
A bar magnet attracts ferromagnetic metals like iron nails and nickel coins, but completely ignores aluminum foil.
Electric current in a copper wire is actually the flow of negatively charged electrons from the negative terminal.
Sunlight travels through the empty vacuum of outer space to reach Earth because light does not require a physical medium.
A whale's song travels over four times faster in water than in air because water molecules are packed closer together.
When ice melts in your hand, thermal heat energy flows from your warmer hand into the colder ice.
Lighting a match does not create energy, but converts the stored chemical energy in the wood into heat and light.
A movable pulley attached to a heavy bucket halves the effort force you need to pull the rope upward.
The moon possesses its own gravitational pull, which is why a spacesuit weighs only one-sixth of its Earth weight there.
Passing white sunlight through a glass prism separates it into the seven distinct colors of the visible light spectrum.
